plant.name: Meridian Fabrication, Plant 2
plant.note: Fictional plant. All SOPs, histories, parts and readings in this repository are synthetic.

sops.title: Spindle bearing wear — diagnose and replace

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out CNC-3 at isolator M-3 and verify zero energy before opening the spindle housing.
Wear cut-resistant gloves and eye protection when handling the spindle cartridge and bearings.

diagnostic_checks: Spindle vibration above 7.0 mm/s RMS with spindle temperature above 80 C points to bearing wear.
Rule out tool imbalance first: tool-holder runout above 0.02 mm explains vibration without bearing damage; runout at or below 0.02 mm rules imbalance out.

corrective_steps.text: Drain the spindle coolant circuit to the bunded container.
Remove the spindle nose, press out the worn bearing set and fit replacement bearing BRG-6208.
Refit, refill coolant, and run the 20-minute spindle run-in cycle before returning the machine to production.

sops.title: Tool imbalance — check runout and swap holder

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out CNC-3 at isolator M-3 and verify zero energy before opening the spindle housing.

diagnostic_checks: Tool-holder runout above 0.02 mm with normal spindle temperature indicates imbalance rather than bearing wear.

corrective_steps.text: Remove the tool holder, clean the taper, and fit balanced holder TOOL-HSK63.
Run a test cut at production speed and confirm vibration is below 4.5 mm/s.

sops.title: Coolant system fault — filter and flow check

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out CNC-3 at isolator M-3 and verify zero energy before opening the spindle housing.
Place spill containment under the coolant filter housing before opening it.

diagnostic_checks: Coolant flow below 4 L/min or coolant pressure below 1.2 bar with rising spindle temperature indicates a blocked coolant filter.

corrective_steps.text: Replace the coolant filter cartridge (CLNT-FLT; extended-life CLNT-FLT-E is an approved substitute).
Restore flow and confirm coolant flow is at least 8 L/min at the nozzle.

CLNT-FLT.basis: Same spin-on M22 fitting and housing; the extended-life element is approved for CNC-3 coolant service.

spec_deltas.note: finer filtration — exceeds the SOP cleanliness requirement
longer change interval; no plan change

CLNT-FLT.reason: the coolant cleanliness class the CNC-3 spindle bearings require

sops.title: Spindle cartridge failure — vendor exchange

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out CNC-2 at isolator M-2 and verify zero energy before touching the spindle.

diagnostic_checks: A seized spindle (will not rotate by hand with the drive isolated) or metallic debris in the spindle nose indicates cartridge failure; there is no in-house repair.

corrective_steps.text: Remove the failed cartridge and fit the vendor-exchange cartridge SPN-CART.

sops.title: Hydraulic pressure loss — ram seal replacement

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out PRESS-1 at the main isolator, dump hydraulic pressure to tank, and verify zero pressure on the gauge before opening any hydraulic fitting.
Fit the ram safety blocks before working under the raised ram.

diagnostic_checks: Ram pressure falling more than 10 percent under a steady load, with oil at the ram gland, indicates seal bypass.

corrective_steps.text: Strip the ram gland and fit seal kit HYD-SEAL.
Refill, bleed air, and hold a 10-minute pressure test at rated load before releasing the press.

sops.title: Weld quality drift (porosity) — gas and consumables check

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Isolate WELD-4 and allow welded parts to cool before handling; wear welding PPE for any test welds.

diagnostic_checks: Porosity above 2 percent of inspected welds points first to shielding-gas flow or a worn contact tip, not to the power source.
Gas flow below 12 L/min at the torch is below specification for this cell.

corrective_steps.text: Measure shielding-gas flow at the torch and restore it to 14-16 L/min; record the regulator reading.
Fit new contact tips TIP-08 to both torches.
Run three test welds and inspect for porosity before releasing the cell to production.

sops.title: Wire feed fault — liner and drive rolls

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Isolate WELD-4 and allow welded parts to cool before handling; wear welding PPE for any test welds.

diagnostic_checks: Erratic wire feed speed or bird-nesting at the drive rolls indicates a worn or kinked wire liner.

corrective_steps.text: Replace the wire liner with LINER-045 and re-tension the drive rolls.

sops.title: Belt tracking fault — align and inspect

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out CONV-5 at the line isolator before reaching into the belt path; keep guards in place while jogging the belt.

diagnostic_checks: Belt edge wear on one side with the tracking sensor flagging drift indicates roller misalignment; check motor current — a seized roller also raises drive current.

corrective_steps.text: Realign the tracking rollers and re-tension the belt.
If the belt edge is frayed beyond the wear mark, fit belt section BELT-5M.

sops.title: Drive motor overheat — cooling and load check

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out CONV-5 at the line isolator before reaching into the belt path; keep guards in place while jogging the belt.

diagnostic_checks: Motor casing temperature above 90 C with drive current above rating indicates overload or failed cooling; a current reading is required to separate the two.

corrective_steps.text: Clean the motor cooling fins and fan cowl; clear any product build-up around the motor.
Run the conveyor empty for five minutes and record motor current and casing temperature.

sops.title: Compressor cooling fan failure — replace fan assembly

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out COMP-7 and vent the air receiver to zero pressure before opening the compressor enclosure.

diagnostic_checks: Discharge temperature climbing above 105 C with the cooling fan not running indicates fan failure; the compressor must not run unloaded-hot for extended periods.

corrective_steps.text: Replace the cooling fan assembly with FAN-C7.
Run the compressor for 15 minutes and confirm discharge temperature settles below 95 C.

FAN-C7.basis: Same 4-bolt COMP-7 flange mount and connector; a generic assembly the stores keep as a stopgap.

spec_deltas.note: lower rated airflow than the OEM assembly

FAN-C7.reason: discharge cooling at full load — the compressor overheats below 420 m3/h of fan airflow

sops.title: Low discharge pressure — intake filter and leaks

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Lock out and tag out COMP-7 and vent the air receiver to zero pressure before opening the compressor enclosure.

diagnostic_checks: Discharge pressure below 6.2 bar with a clogged intake filter (high filter differential) indicates intake restriction.

corrective_steps.text: Replace the intake air filter AIR-FLT.
Walk the ring main with the ultrasonic leak detector and tag any leaks found.

sops.title: Heat-seal temperature drift — seal bar replacement

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Isolate PACK-6 and let the seal bar cool below 40 C before touching the sealing head (burn risk).

diagnostic_checks: Seal strength failures scattered across a shift, with indicated seal temperature swinging more than 15 C, indicate a failing seal-bar element rather than a settings problem.

corrective_steps.text: Replace the heat seal bar with SEAL-BAR and re-run the temperature calibration.
Run twenty test seals and pull-test five before releasing the packer.

sops.title: Label printer fault — print head

mandatory_safety_steps.text: Isolate PACK-6 and let the seal bar cool below 40 C before touching the sealing head (burn risk).

diagnostic_checks: A consistent blank stripe down every label indicates a dead print-head element row.

corrective_steps.text: Replace the thermal print head with PRT-HEAD and print a test label set.

sops.title: Material shortage — confirm, substitute, expedite
diagnostic_checks: Confirm the shortage against physical stock, not the system figure alone; check whether an approved substitute material is on the shelf before expediting.

corrective_steps.text: Physically confirm the stockout at the stores location and record the count.
Raise an expedite request against the open purchase order and note the promised time for the shift handover.

FILM-PKG.basis: Same 450 mm width and core; grade B film is approved for the retail-carton packing this SOP covers.

spec_deltas.note: lower grade — the supervisor sees this delta on the record
grade B is not food-contact rated; the lines this SOP covers pack retail cartons, not food
thinner film — still above the seal-jaw minimum in the constraints

FILM-PKG.reason: the PACK-6 seal jaw is 450 mm wide
seal integrity on the PACK-6 jaw below 35 um is unreliable

history.summary: Vibration 7.9 mm/s and spindle at 84 C on the morning run; bearing set found scored on strip-down.
history.resolution: Bearing set replaced under SOP-CNC3-BRG; run-in completed.

history.summary: Vibration complaint traced to a chipped tool holder; runout measured 0.05 mm.
history.resolution: Holder swapped; vibration back to 3.8 mm/s.

history.summary: Coolant flow fell to 3.1 L/min over a weekend; filter cartridge blinded with swarf fines.
history.resolution: Extended-life filter fitted; flow restored to 9.4 L/min.

history.summary: Ram pressure sagged 14 percent under load with oil weeping at the gland.
history.resolution: Seal kit fitted; pressure held on the 10-minute test.

history.summary: Porosity spiked to 5.8 percent after a cylinder change; gas flow at the torch was 9 L/min.
history.resolution: Regulator replaced, flow set to 15 L/min, tips changed; test welds clean.

history.summary: Belt drifted to the west edge and frayed; two rollers found out of parallel.
Discharge temperature hit 112 C; fan motor winding open-circuit.
history.resolution: Fan assembly replaced (part had to be ordered; 2 days on reduced load).

history.summary: Seal failures clustered on night shift; seal bar element resistance out of range.
history.resolution: Seal bar replaced and calibrated; pull tests passed.
